gitleaks.needs: the `gitleaks git` subcommand (Ubuntu's apt gitleaks 8.18 does not have it)

argv: d=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d) || exit 1; clang++ -std=c++20 -fsanitize=undefined -x c++ -o "$d/p" - && "$d/p"; r=$?; /bin/rm -rf "$d"; exit $r
clang++.stdin:
consteval int zero() { return 0; }
int main() { return zero(); }
clang++.needs: C++20 with -fsanitize=undefined (compile, link the UBSan runtime, run)

argv: d=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d) || exit 1; rustc --edition 2021 --crate-type lib --emit metadata -o "$d/p" -; r=$?; /bin/rm -rf "$d"; exit $r

hints.clang++: sudo apt-get install clang libclang-rt-dev (clang alone does not bring the UBSan runtime)
hints.rustc: sudo apt-get install rustc (puts rustc in /usr/bin)
hints.gitleaks: install the gitleaks release binary into /usr/local/bin, checksum-verified against the release's checksums file (docs/apx-linux-host.md, step 5)
hints.node: install the repo's Node toolchain under the shared toolchains directory (docs/apx-linux-host.md, step 5)
hints.npm: comes with the repo's Node toolchain (docs/apx-linux-host.md, step 5)
hints.npx: comes with the repo's Node toolchain (docs/apx-linux-host.md, step 5)
hints.pawl: install the pinned pawl build root-owned into the shared toolchains directory; the sandbox has no GitHub token (docs/apx-linux-host.md, step 5)

python3.hint: install PyYAML into the toolchains directory's pawl-VERSION venv, whose python3 is first on control's PATH (docs/apx-linux-host.md, step 5)
